redaction_policy: Original TSVs unchanged. In newly captured logs and receipts, local absolute path prefixes replaced with named placeholders; raw digest retained.
public_identifiers_allowlisted: explicitly supplied public GitHub repository/PR URL
source commit IDs and file digests
scope_limitation: Pattern checks plus independent content review; not a claim of exhaustive secret detection. Original/raw files retained locally.

independent_review.method: separate agent read-only content, digest, provenance and privacy audit

archival_whitespace_policy: .gitattributes allows Rust stdout trailing blank lines only in logs/recapture/*.log; archival bytes are not trimmed.
